core_memory.user_hobbies_gaming: I enjoy playing PC and console games, especially co-op survival games and fast-paced shooters. Gaming is a great way to relax, challenge myself, and stay connected with friends. I also have an interest in game development and hope to explore it further in the future.
core_memory.user_hobbies_reading: I enjoy reading fantasy and sci-fi novels, especially those that explore the intersection of technology and humanity. Reading helps me relax and also allows me to consider the ethical and social implications of emerging technologies.
core_memory.user_hobbies_scheduling: I schedule my hobbies just like I schedule study time to maintain a healthy balance. By planning ahead, I can ensure that I have time for activities like sailing, gym workouts, gaming, and reading. It helps me stay organized and enjoy my free time.

archival_memory.user_research_experience: I have been involved in undergraduate research since the end of my sophomore year, which has been a truly eye-opening experience. It has given me a glimpse into how knowledge is created in the tech world, and I feel fortunate to be a part of it. Initially, I didn't see myself pursuing research, but after being approached by one of my professors who recognized my ability to bridge technical coding with user experience, I decided to take the leap. It has been a great decision, and I'm grateful for the opportunity to contribute to a lab focused on data visualization for big scientific datasets.
